family: Original documentation navigation and style-guide illustrations
creator: civica.uk project; Codex-assisted original editable SVG geometry
licence: MIT, original repository documentation artwork under LICENSE
source: Original rectangles, circles and filled paths authored for this repository. No official GOV.UK artwork, marks, dot-derived device, supplied civica identity geometry, screenshots or third-party SVG paths were imported.
scope: Documentation navigation: seven section landings, three key style guides and three matching homepage cards. Not an in-home identity requirement or runtime interface change.
background: Opaque #F3F6F9 canvas in every asset, retained on both light and dark surroundings; shapes use the existing restrained blue documentation family.
family_decisions: Flat filled geometry with no gradients, filters, shadows, texture or ornamental strokes.
Simple relationships are explained by objects, whitespace and scale; no tiny baked labels or private household values.
A large original letterform stands for typography. Short bars stand for text or table rows; they are not readable copy or measured data.
Functional selection, task acknowledgement and keyboard-focus schematics use blue/white shape contrast, not borrowed red/amber/green status roles.
People, diagnoses, household roles and demographic traits are not inferred.
The existing original household hero remains unchanged and shares this five-colour family.

Colour-combination swatches pair light marks with dark/primary surfaces and dark marks with the pale blue surface. The data schematic uses stronger primary/dark colours for its meaningful bars and table rows.
Header scenes reuse the existing object paths with uniform scale and regroup them into a compact 4:3 composition for the large hero art panel. No object is cropped or distorted.

Homepage styles/components/patterns artwork remains byte-identical. Its horizontal scenes and the corresponding regrouped headers share the same original letterform, swatches, components and task-step objects.

alt_decision.condition: Use empty alt only when the adjacent HTML title and introduction already explain the same topic and relationship. The illustration must not be the only navigation name or instruction.
alt_decision.informative_reuse: Use the per-asset informative_alt when the adjacent text does not carry that relationship. Keep any essential explanation as HTML.
alt_decision.standalone_svg: Each editable SVG has role=img and an explicit title and description.
alt_decision.caption_requirement: Section header decoration needs no extra caption when its adjacent introduction supplies the message. Reuse as a data figure requires explicit identification as a schematic, not measured data.

verification.source_checks: Passed for all ten recomposed headers: XML,640×480 viewBox, names, unchanged original object geometry, five-colour family, no added labels/scripts/embedded images/ornamental strokes. All three homepage category files remain byte-identical to the prior published revision.
verification.render_checks: Rendered each revised header at 640px and 320px. All 20 cases have no document overflow; transformed object bounds stay within the complete viewBox. Visually inspected both contact sheets and the refined Data/Accessibility mobile proofs.
verification.context_checks: Visually inspected dark-surround, grayscale and images-omitted proof sheets. The opaque pale canvas and object relationships remain intact, with each topic and purpose retained as HTML.
manual_refinements: Regrouped horizontal objects into compact scenes for the right-hand hero panel, preserving all object proportions.
Added breathing room beneath the data-table schematic and made the enlarged-text schematic visibly larger than its source text.
verification.scope_limit: Local original-artwork proofs only. Grayscale checks loss of colour, not every colour-vision deficiency. Integrated hero dimensions, reading order, text enlargement and navigation need separate page-level verification; no live Home Assistant or accessibility certification is claimed.

integration.placement: Large hero beside the HTML title and introduction on desktop, with the artwork panel extending towards the viewport right edge. Stack text above the complete artwork at narrow widths.
integration.responsive_rule: Preserve the 4:3 artwork ratio and its entire viewBox; use automatic sizing or object-fit:contain. Do not crop, stretch or recolour the objects. Hero height may grow with text size.
integration.image_loading: Use normal loading for the above-the-fold hero. Explicit intrinsic width and height preserve the artwork aspect ratio.
integration.scope: Section landing pages and the three named key style guides; no blanket injection into component detail pages.

revision_history.change: Recomposed the ten header scenes for a substantial right-hand hero panel after the earlier wide strip was rejected. The three homepage category assets are unchanged.

previous_verification.source_checks: Passed for all 13 assets: XML parse, explicit dimensions/viewBox, named title/description, four or five colours from the shared five-colour family, matching hashes, no SVG text nodes, ornamental strokes, gradients, filters, scripts, embedded images or event handlers.
previous_verification.render_checks: Rendered every asset at 960px and 320px display width using local Playwright Chromium headless shell build 1243. Visually inspected both header contact sheets and the mobile family, plus the updated colour/data mobile proofs. No document overflow was reported in 26 asset/width cases.
previous_verification.context_checks: Visually inspected dark-surround, grayscale and images-omitted proof sheets. The source canvas stays opaque and unchanged; object relationships remain visible without colour. The accompanying HTML title and purpose remain when images are omitted.
manual_refinements: Changed the colour-guide swatch marks to retain clear foreground/background combinations.
Changed the data-guide columns and table rows to stronger primary/dark paints.
previous_verification.scope_limit: Local artwork proofs only. Grayscale is a loss-of-colour check, not a simulation of every colour-vision deficiency. No live Home Assistant, end-user study or accessibility certification is claimed. Parent integration must verify the actual page layout, nearby explanations, reading order and navigation.

layout_reference_review.observed_layout: At 1440px viewport width the official header occupies a 450px-high region from the main-content left edge to the viewport right edge, with HTML text left and substantial artwork right. This informs the page composition only.
layout_reference_review.artwork_boundary: No official illustration paths, marks or palette are reused.
